ListContractsItem

ListContractsResponse

Response of ListarContratos (servicos/contrato) — the page of Service Contracts registered in Omie. A contract is a price registry: it holds the negotiated value and the validity period agreed with one client, and must never be billed through.

The listing exists so callers can resolve a contract by the number the user knows (cNumCtr) without asking Omie one call per contract: Omie exposes no search by contract number, and repeated single consults are what trips its "Consumo redundante" gate. List once, index in memory — the same approach as the service catalog.

OmieCategory

OmieContractInfo

A Service Contract of Omie as callers consume it: the number the user knows, the validity period and the negotiated value, with the dates already parsed. Projected from the listing so no caller has to deal with Omie's dd/MM/yyyy strings or with which key carries what.

OmieInvoiceRpsStatus

RPS and batch status codes in Omie (cStatusRps / cStatusLote), as documented by the API. Both fields use the same three digits.

OmieServiceDetail

The full registration of a service (ConsultarCadastroServico). The listing does not carry these fields and including a service order requires them on every item: LC 116 service code, municipal service code and tax classification. None of them can be invented — when they are missing from the Omie registration, the caller should stop and say which service to fix.

OmieServiceInfo

A service of the Omie catalog, as ListarCadastroServico returns it.

The two codes exist and are not interchangeable: Code is the business code (cCodigo, e.g. "SRV00016"), the one applications store in their own configuration, while ServiceCode is Omie's internal identifier (nCodServico), the only one accepted when building service order items. Translating one into the other is the reason the whole catalog is read.

OmieServiceInvoiceStatus

The service invoice (NFS-e) of a service order and the progress of the RPS it came from. Issuing is a process, not an instant: Omie transmits the RPS and the city hall authorizes it later, so there is a window in which the invoice exists as a request and has no number yet.

OmieServiceOrderStatus

Fiscal state of a service order in Omie, as StatusOS returns it: which stage it sits in, whether it was cancelled, whether it was already invoiced and — when it was — the NFS-e that came out of it.

Interfaces

IOmieBusinessStatus

Marker for Omie response DTOs that carry a business-level status code in the body. Omie returns HTTP 200 even when the operation didn't succeed at the business level — the body's status code is the real outcome.
